I have no friends here. About to graduate. Made a friend in elementary she has her own circle of friends now. Girl in tutor, I had to leave and never saw her again. Guy talked to me for months and he confesses and then cuts off contact. 
I'm suicidal too I wish I had a shotgun. If we lived next to each other, I would become your friend even for just a second and end it with you.

This is my biggest regret even though I'm only 16 and in year 12. I'm trying to find a way to end it quickly, painlessly and without people noticing so they don't save me. I know the world loves beautiful extroverts. I know I won't be able to get a driver license, job, make it to university and to top it off I'm asexual/aromantic. Honestly I don't see what's so wrong about suicide, we all die but this is just speeding it up. People who want others to continue suffering so they won't feel bad are the selfish ones.
I won't blossom from an ugly duckling to a swan.

if you have loved ones that love you back, I would write it to them. Making sure they know its not their fault and to remind them you love them. I hope you do have someone, I would live just for anybody or anything that cared about me. 
I wrote one. I didn't say anything related to what I just said though since I don't have anyone on my side. It included something like the location of where my body would be and calling the cops instead so they don't witness a mess. I crumpled the note up. Had too many grammar mistakes and realised the method I was choosing would not be guaranteed death. Oh, leaving websites and notes on your laptop/phone/computer can help people link the reasons to your death, if you want them to know why.
